context:
Goal: no session works from a stale or missing copy of a repo it needs.
Problem (rule): your 11:06 CST note asked runner 11 to keep its checkouts fresh "on all those repos"; runner 11 then tried to clone 7 sweep repos (session-mailbox, inbox-engine, advisor, brewer-kyc, mailaudit-data, frag-head-beta, note-scrape), and the auto-mode check refused it as relayed.
Based on (read): the gather lane (outbox-aggregate-plan) already attached these 7 read-only at 11:08 CST; runner 11 merges in q_max, home, banchi, joyous, ios-adblock and mailaudit, and all six were fresh at 11:10 CST.
Departs from: main, where runner 11 holds its six merge repos — b adds read-only clones of 7 more.

options.gain: No second session holds copies of repos it does not merge in.
options.how: Runner 11 drops the clones. The gather lane already attached these repos read-only under item 660 and reads them for the sweep.
options.label: No: only the gather lane reads them (Recommended)
options.lose: If you meant runner 11 to merge in these repos too, that waits for a new ask.

options.gain: Runner 11 has fresh copies of every repo in the sweep.
options.how: Type "yes, clone the 7 sweep repos read-only" in runner 11's session (link below); the cloud refuses the act on a relayed word.
options.label: Yes: runner 11 clones the 7 read-only
options.lose: A second session holds copies it has no merge job in yet.

ref: coordinator 11:12 CST Nov 13; your 11:06 CST note on item 660

shown.label: No: only the gather lane reads them (Recommended)

title: Should batch runner 11 also clone the 7 sweep repos read-only?
why: The cloud refused runner 11's clone on a relayed word, so only you can say yes, in its session.
